newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN SENT IN TO BAT BY WALSH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN SENT IN TO BAT BY WALSH.

text.p: West Indies captain Courtney Walsh won the toss and sent Pakistan into bat in their limited overs World Series match at the Gabba on Friday.
West Indies fast bowler Curtly Ambrose passed a fitness test on a hamstring strain but number three batsman Shivnarine Chanderpaul was ruled out because of a tooth infection.
Pakistan made one change from the side that beat Australia by four wickets in Sydney on Wednesday, resting leg-spinner Mushtaq Ahmed in favour of fast bowler Mohammed Zahid.
Australia and Pakistan lead the triangular competition with four points each, two points clear of West Indies. Australia have played one more game than their rivals.
West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Junior Murray, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Jimmy Adams, Robert Samuels, Adrian Griffith, Ian Bishop, Nixon McLean, Curtly Ambrose, Courtney Walsh, Roland Holder 12th man.
Pakistan - Shahid Afridi, Aamir Sohail, Zahoor Elahi, Ijaz Ahmed, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Mohammad Wasim, Moin Khan, Wasim Akram, Saqlain Mushtaq, Shahid Nazir, Mohammed Zahid, Mushtaq Ahmed 12th man.
